q1_路 4:18-21.text: 主的灵在我身上，因为他用膏膏我，叫我传福音给贫穷的人；差遣我报告：被掳的得释放，瞎眼的得看见，叫那受压制的得自由，报告神悦纳人的禧年。于是把书卷起来，交还执事，就坐下。会堂里的人都定睛看他。耶稣对他们说：今天这经应验在你们耳中了。
q1_路 4:18-21.ccb: “主的灵在我身上， 因为他用膏膏我， 叫我传福音给贫穷的人； 差遣我报告： 被掳的得释放， 瞎眼的得看见， 叫那受压制的得自由，报告　神悦纳人的禧年。”于是把书卷起来，交还执事，就坐下。会堂里的人都定睛看他。耶稣对他们说：“今天这经应验在你们耳中了。”
q1_路 4:18-21.csb: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim release to the captives and recovery ...to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor.He then rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. And the eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fixed on him.He began by saying to them, “Today as you listen, this Scripture has been fulfilled.”
q1_路 4:18-21.esv: 'The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free, to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor.' Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him. He began by saying to them, 'Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.'

q2_约一 3:8.text: 犯罪的是属魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。神的儿子显现出来，为要除灭魔鬼的作为。
q2_约一 3:8.ccb: 犯罪的是属魔鬼，因为魔鬼从起初就犯罪。　神的儿子显现出来，为要除灭魔鬼的作为。
q2_约一 3:8.csb: 3:8 The one who commits sin is of the devil, for the devil has sinned from the beginning. The Son of God was revealed for this purpose: to destroy the devil’s wo...
q2_约一 3:8.esv: Whoever makes a practice of sinning is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the works of the devil.

q3_弗 6:12.text: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战（原文作摔跤；下同），乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。
q3_弗 6:12.ccb: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战（两“争战”原文都作“摔跤”）。
q3_弗 6:12.csb: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers of this darkness, against evil, s...
q3_弗 6:12.esv: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.

q4_徒 16:14.text: 有一个卖紫色布疋的妇人，名叫吕底亚，是推雅推喇城的人，素来敬拜神。他听见了，主就开导他的心，叫他留心听保罗所讲的话。
q4_徒 16:14.ccb: 有一个卖紫色布匹的妇人，名叫吕底亚，是推雅推喇城的人，素来敬拜　神。她听见了，主就开导她的心，叫她留心听保罗所讲的话。
q4_徒 16:14.csb: A God-fearing woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, was listening. The Lord opened her heart to respond to what Paul was say...
q4_徒 16:14.esv: One of those listening was a woman from the city of Thyatira named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth. She was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul's message.

q5_林后 4:4.text: 此等不信之人被这世界的神弄瞎了心眼，不叫基督荣耀福音的光照著他们。基督本是神的像。
q5_林后 4:4.ccb: 此等不信之人被这世界的神弄瞎了心眼，不叫基督荣耀福音的光照着他们。基督本是　神的像。
q5_林后 4:4.csb: 4:4 In their case, the god of this age has blinded the minds of the unbelievers to keep them from seeing the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is t...
q5_林后 4:4.esv: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so that they cannot see the light of the gospel that displays the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.

q6_西 2:8.text: 你们要谨慎，恐怕有人用他的理学和虚空的妄言，不照著基督，乃照人间的遗传和世上的小学就把你们掳去。
q6_西 2:8.ccb: 你们要谨慎，恐怕有人用他的理学和虚空的妄言，不照着基督，乃照人间的遗传和世上的小学就把你们掳去。
q6_西 2:8.csb: Be careful that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deceit based on human tradition, based on the elements of the world, rather than Christ.
q6_西 2:8.esv: See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition and the elemental spiritual forces of this world rather than on Christ.

q7_徒 8:6-8.text: 众人听见了，又看见腓利所行的神迹，就同心合意的听从他的话。因为有许多人被污鬼附著，那些鬼大声呼叫，从他们身上出来；还有许多瘫痪的，瘸腿的，都得了医治。在那城里，就大有欢喜。
q7_徒 8:6-8.ccb: 众人听见了，又看见腓利所行的神迹，就同心合意地听从他的话。因为有许多人被污鬼附着，那些鬼大声呼叫，从他们身上出来；还有许多瘫痪的、瘸腿的，都得了医治。在那城里，就大有欢喜。
q7_徒 8:6-8.csb: The crowds were all paying attention to what Philip said, as they listened and saw the signs he was performing.For unclean spirits, crying out with a loud voice, came out of many who were possessed, and many who were paralyzed and lame were healed.So there was great joy in that city.
q7_徒 8:6-8.esv: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

q8_雅 5:14-15.text: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。出于信心的祈祷要救那病人，主必叫他起来；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
q8_雅 5:14-15.ccb: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。出于信心的祈祷要救那病人，主必叫他起来；他若犯了罪，也必蒙赦免。
q8_雅 5:14-15.csb: Is anyone among you sick? He should call for the elders of the church, and they are to pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.The prayer of faith will save the sick person, and the Lord will raise him up; if he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
q8_雅 5:14-15.esv: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them and anoint them with oil in the name of the Lord. And the prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise them up. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven.

q9_约 14:12.text: 我实实在在的告诉你们，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，并且要做比这更大的事，因为我往父那里去。
q9_约 14:12.ccb: 我实实在在地告诉你们，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，并且要做比这更大的事，因为我往父那里去。
q9_约 14:12.csb: “Truly I tell you, the one who believes in me will also do the works that I do. And he will do even greater works than these, because I am going to the Father.
q9_约 14:12.esv: Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

q10_徒 3:6-7,16.text: 彼得说：金银我都没有，只把我所有的给你：我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，叫你起来行走！于是拉著他的右手，扶他起来；他的脚和踝子骨立刻健壮了，我们因信他的名，他的名便叫你们所看见所认识的这人健壮了；正是他所赐的信心，叫这人在你们众人面前全然好了。
q10_徒 3:6-7,16.ccb: 彼得说：'金子、银子我都没有，但是我把我有的给你。我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，命令你起来行走！'彼得拉着他的右手扶他起来，那人的双脚和踝骨立刻变得强壮有力。你们认识的这个乞丐因为相信耶稣的名，得到了医治。你们都看见了，他能痊愈是因为他信耶稣。
q10_徒 3:6-7,16.csb: 彼得却说：'金子银子我都没有，只把我有的给你：奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，起来 走路吧！'彼得抓着他的右手，扶他起来。他的脚和踝骨立刻就健壮了。现在，基于对他名的信心，他的名就使你们所看见所认识的这个人健壮了；这由耶稣而来的信心，使他在你们众人面前完全康复了。
q10_徒 3:6-7,16.esv: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

q11_太 28:18.text: 耶稣进前来，对他们说：天上地下所有的权柄都赐给我了。
q11_太 28:18.ccb: 耶稣进前来，对他们说：“天上地下所有的权柄都赐给我了。
q11_太 28:18.csb: Jesus came near and said to them, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
q11_太 28:18.esv:
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying,
“All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

q12_太 28:19.text: 所以，你们要去，使万民作我的门徒，奉父、子、圣灵的名给他们施洗（或作：给他们施洗，归于父、子、圣灵的名）。
q12_太 28:19.ccb: 所以，你们要去，使万民作我的门徒，奉父、子、圣灵的名给他们施洗（或作“给他们施洗，归于父、子、圣灵的名”）。

q12_太 28:19.esv:
Go
and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

q13_徒 1:8.text: 但圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必得著能力，并要在耶路撒冷、犹太全地，和撒玛利亚，直到地极，作我的见证。

q13_徒 1:8.csb: 不过圣灵临到你们的时候，你们将得着能力，并且要在 耶路撒冷 ，在 犹太 和 撒玛利亚 全地，直到地极，做我的见证人。”

q15_太 9:35-37.text: 耶稣走遍各城各乡，在会堂里教训人，宣讲天国的福音，又医治各样的病症。他看见许多的人，就怜悯他们；因为他们困苦流离，如同羊没有牧人一般。于是对门徒说：要收的庄稼多，作工的人少。
q15_太 9:35-37.ccb: 耶稣走遍各城各乡，在会堂里教训人，宣讲天国的福音，又医治各样的病症。他看见许多的人，就怜悯他们；因为他们困苦流离，如同羊没有牧人一般。于是对门徒说：“要收的庄稼多，做工的人少。
q15_太 9:35-37.csb: Jesus continued going around to all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease a...When he saw the crowds, he felt compassion for them, because they were distressed and dejected, like sheep without a shepherd.Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest is abundant, but the workers are few.
q15_太 9:35-37.esv: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

q16_太 9:38.text: 所以，你们当求庄稼的主打发工人出去收他的庄稼。

q16_太 9:38.csb: Therefore, pray to the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into his harvest.”
q16_太 9:38.esv: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
